description: What one location did in the last 7, 30 or 90 days: how many posts went out and where, what they got, which did best, what failed and what is scheduled next. `text` is the same thing in plain words, ready for the user to send to the branch or the client: show it to them as it is. Without an id the answer is every location side by side for the same period, with the totals of all of them. Part of Pro; refused on other plans.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: The period, counted back from now: 7, 30 or 90 days. 30 when left out.

id.description: A location id from locations_list. Leave out for every location side by side.

source.description: Which posts to include: "all" (Spica + synced native posts, default), "spica", or "native".

name: locations_report
title: Report for a location
